How luxury living has evolved since 1956. 
Back in the '50s, floor plans prioritized quantity over quality - think six small bedrooms squeezed into standard 8-foot ceilings with just two shared baths.

We’re changing the game on this build:
✨ Raised ceilings from 8ft for expansive volume
✨ Reconfigured from 6 tight bedrooms down to 4 grand suites
✨ Added en-suite baths + walk-in closets for every room
Understanding the "bones" of a home allows us to transform older footprints into highly functional, modern coastal retreats. 🌊
